name: audiogen-cpp
description: ACE-Step text-to-music engine in pure C++/ggml, from qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp's engines/audiogen. This pin (merged commit a73f6bb2, PR #125) treats integrated GPUs as valid compute devices and prefers the validated Vulkan and Metal backends. Vulkan reports Android UMA adapters such as Pixel's Mali-G715 as IGPU, so the previous GPU-only lookup silently fell back to CPU even though the complete Vulkan pipeline was available. The pin was validated on a Pixel 9a with every ACE-Step stage on Vulkan0, non-silent 48 kHz stereo output, and 0.999951 Vulkan/CPU cosine similarity for the FSQ detokenizer. The ggml-speech floor remains 2026-08-04 because it already carries the required Vulkan snake, col2im_1d, quantized CPY, and GGML_PREC_F32 matmul support, along with the Metal kernels required by the previous audiogen release.
